CEHQ identifies provincial station 074903 / federal 02WB003 as open from June 1980 to present, with a 15,693 km² basin at station and a non-influenced flow regime; historical files are validated through 2025-09-30 and later data are preliminary.

Current Kristal Farms source records contain WSC gross drainage area 15400 km² and CEHQ basin-at-station area 15,693 km² for 02WB003. The canonical dataset preserves both observations and does not silently reconcile or overwrite them.

The 2013 Newfoundland and Labrador transboundary hydrology study summarizes station 02WB003 for a 1980–2001 study record: mean annual flows ranged from 271 to 427 m³/s, with study-reported minimum 44.8 m³/s and maximum 2,795 m³/s.

The 2018 NLH/Hatch Annex states WSC gauge 03QC002 on the Alexis River was active and had collected data since 1978; those historical flows were used as the reference series for correlations with Gilbert and St. Lewis River gauges.

For 2013–2016 overlapping measurements, the 2018 NLH/Hatch report gives Gilbert monthly mean flow = 0.2452 × Alexis monthly mean flow − 0.6982, with R² = 0.9585; the regression was used to synthesize a 1978–2016 Gilbert monthly series.

For 2012–2016 overlapping measurements, the 2018 NLH/Hatch report gives St. Lewis monthly mean flow = 1.1183 × Alexis monthly mean flow + 4.0123, with R² = 0.9669; the regression was used to synthesize a 1978–2016 St. Lewis monthly series.
